parsed.why: Paper anti-discrimination law unenforced: police use morals statute to harass/detain trans women, documented extortion and rape, birth-sex prison placement with guard-complicit rape and prosecutorial inaction, impunity, two activist killings. State-tolerated targeting plus tier-1 custody exposure.

Active criminalisation upheld 2024, enforced against gender-nonconforming people: trans woman got 8 years in a men's prison, another 14; police arbitrary arrest/assault, forced stripping and exams, official hostility. Near-extreme, short of execution.

No trans criminal offence, protective Supreme Court rulings, self-ID on paper and embedded third-gender tradition; but documented public-institution discrimination, physical/sexual harassment in provincial cities, and rising anti-LGBTQ political hostility.

Decriminalised 2021 but no protections: police dismiss trans victims' complaints because IDs read male, documented impunity, trans people four times likelier to be assaulted, health-care stigma. No criminalisation floor, no working remedy.

Trans-inclusive hate-speech, anti-discrimination and hate-crime law; self-ID; liberal society; Pride shooter given maximum 30 years. Offset by rising hate crime, clearance falling 52% to 45%, 8% reporting rate, extremist hostility.
